therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Arsenic trioxide induces degradation of PML-RARA fusion protein; Tretinoin promotes differentiation of promyelocytes
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Elimination of leukemic promyelocytes and restoration of normal hematopoiesis
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Young patients with newly diagnosed acute promyelocytic leukemia

biomarker_changes: Hematologic remission rate: Standard Risk 100%, High Risk 88.24%
Combined hematologic, molecular, and cytogenetic remission: Standard Risk 80.95%, High Risk 58.82%
subgroup_findings: Standard risk patients had superior outcomes compared to high risk patients across all endpoints
results.dose_information: Multiple agents given IV, orally, and intrathecally per protocol schedule

context.duration: 3 years follow-up, treatment up to 9 months
